Variants.Content: The social order of antiquity was rooted in Fides Publica Treaty Faithfulness. Governing religious duties, family lineages, political offices, and sacred treaties, it established the moral boundaries and civic expectations that bound citizens to their respective commonwealths.

Without Fides Publica Treaty Faithfulness, the commonwealth dissolves into anarchy and civil bloodshed. It is the sacred duty of magistrates and elders to uphold these ancient pillars against moral decay and foreign corruption.
From childhood our elders taught us to revere Fides Publica Treaty Faithfulness. Break the sacred custom, and the wrath of gods and magistrates will surely crush your household.
